review_2026_10_02.attack: Native AttackSwipe1/2 both use cast_slow at main clip start; swing scheduled at first_hit after native in clip. Both OnHit events resolve to the same four-media random container.
review_2026_10_02.Q: Native ultimate in clip uses BelvethQ_cast; real path hits use BelvethQ_hit. ToRun/ToIdle have no sound events.
review_2026_10_02.death: No death animation. Keep independent death event with standard 1.5s envelope.
review_2026_10_02.headroom: Previous PCM16 files clipped Vorbis float overshoots (max source peak 1.526758); all clips re-decoded as float and attenuated by a shared 6 dB before quantization.
